title: A Private Conversation

narrative.text: Vael thanks you for the university contract. His tone suggests he is thanking you for more than just a construction project.

The university expansion is a noble project. Education is the future. I would like to personally contribute to your household's education fund — 2,500 ₭, discreetly transferred. Think of it as a scholarship. For your children.

monologue: He called it a scholarship. For the children. He knows exactly where to aim — not at my ambition, which is armored, but at the one thing every parent fears: not doing enough. Clever. And revolting. And still — the money would mean something for Tomas and Liora. That is why he put it there.

reactions.text: He makes a note — scholarship fund, 2,500 — and closes the ledger. He does not look at you. The transaction is already categorized in his mind.

choices.text: "My children's education is not for sale, Vael. Build the university. That is your contribution."

reactions.text: He looks at you — the long look of a man who aimed at the children and missed. The silence is the sound of Lucan Vael recalibrating.
